preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices, both of which are numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == m // 2 and all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No solution' or a list of m//2 paths, each described by three space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or all(set(map(int, line.split())) in set(edges) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each path in the output corresponds to an edge in the input graph.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or all(len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == 3 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each path in the output is a path of length 2, connecting three distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or all(len(set(map(tuple, (line.split()[0], line.split()[1]), (line.split()[1], line.split()[2])))) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each path in the output consists of two adjacent edges sharing a common vertex.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' or len(set(edge for line in stdout.splitlines() for edge in ((int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])), (int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2])))) == m
postconditions.description: Each edge in the input graph appears in exactly one path in the output.
